children: Matthews International will continue to evaluate strategic alternatives in 2027, according to Chief Executive Michael Whitehead

"As we enter fiscal 2027, economic uncertainty and litigation affecting our engineering business remain significant considerations," Whitehead said, adding that the industrial manufacturing company wouldn't provide full-year guidance at this time.
Shares fell 4.5%, to $18.52, in after-hours trading Thursday. The stock is down 26% year to date.
The company on Thursday posted a fourth-quarter loss of $19.5 million, or 62 cents a share, compared with $27.5 million, or 88 cents a share, the year earlier.
Adjusted earnings per share were 39 cents, ahead of the 27 cents expected from analysts polled by FactSet.
